notes.title: September Update - Preview!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We are excited to share with you our latest progress and update! As we continue working on the release of the Wildlands Update, we are planning to provide another patch with some core functionality changes along with new features. We will provide highlights to the new features which include overhaul of our Fuel System, Warmth, along with the new framing system workflow. In addition we have an expansive list of notes that improve AI Villagers, Navigation, Gameplay Systems, Events, and more. 

For more information feel free to join us in a deeper walkthrough of our September Update Highlights!
[/p][previewyoutube="r5u4-hEfodo;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"][/img][b]

You can swap between preview modes by equipping and unequipping your hammer.

Villagers will automatically maintain their homes fuel level as long as your market storage is fed sufficient fuel. [b] [/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/5d0f5f092870588f3f1e1aaf264eb846a54b331e.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New Feature: Financial tracking[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Financial breakdown available in kingdom menu[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New [b]Production Toggle[/b]: production furniture (e.g., forager’s basket) can now be enabled/disabled manually with Q.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new [b]Halloween assets[/b]: scarecrow, gravestones, pumpkins, icons.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Expanded décor: [b]new rugs, castle wall battlements, bookshelves, light posts, hearth, new crop visuals[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/83e92e8b764919fe3d75abfbf10471a05aee8df5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"][/img][/p][h2]Community Spotlight[/h2][p]

tags.feature: New Feature: [b]Builder’s Lodge[/b]
The Builders Lodge built with the new Builders Tool Rack is a dedicated structure for the new Labourer job roles in which peasants assigned to labourer will construct your buildings for you!
New Feature: [b]Labourer Role[/b]
New Feature: [b]Building Framing System[/b]

A new build system is in place with the all new building framing system - where you can plan out your structures in which frames are placed for your villagers to build. You can swap between preview modes by equipping and unequipping your hammer.
New Feature[b]: Hearth (Warmth and Fuel Overhaul)[/b]

Warm and Fuel has been re-designed by requiring Hearths to be placed in villager homes to properly warm them. Villagers will automatically maintain their homes fuel level as long as your market storage is fed sufficient fuel. [b]
New Feature: Financial tracking
Financial breakdown available in kingdom menu
New [b]Production Toggle[/b]: production furniture (e.g., forager’s basket) can now be enabled/disabled manually with Q.
Added new [b]Halloween assets[/b]: scarecrow, gravestones, pumpkins, icons.
Expanded décor: [b]new rugs, castle wall battlements, bookshelves, light posts, hearth, new crop visuals[/b]

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re now three weeks into Early Access, and we are truly humbled by the incredible support from our community and friends here in [i]Noble Legacy[/i]. Your contributions, feedback, and especially the dedication of our Discord Focus Testers have been invaluable in helping us refine the game through rapid hotfixes and content updates. We sincerely thank you for being a vital part of this journey. And what better way to celebrate than with a visit to the local tavern?  

We’re excited to introduce [b]Heather[/b], our newest Villager! Much like other tradespeople, she’s here to lend a hand in your settlement—but her true calling lies in tavern keeping. [i][b]Please enjoy this free addition as a small token of our gratitude for your continued support.[/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/309a41a74a447e86bb92c7d4fcb3649530fc4730.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Updated Roadmap and Long Term Vision[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Due to the incredible response and observing players feedback as well as aligning our vision and goals with Noble Legacy, we have updated our roadmap to further communicate key systems that are coming and how they align with the long term vision of our game. 

[/p][h3][b]Kingdom Mode[/b][/h3][p]
We’re placing our primary focus on [b]Kingdom Mode[/b], our flagship game mode, to ensure the systems and mechanics that drive the long-term gameplay loop are fully realized.[/p][p]Kingdom Mode emphasizes [b]endless replayability[/b], balancing design and mechanics with punishing challenges—such as morale-driven riots, shifting loyalties after the Norman Conquest, and difficult choices around raids, taxation, and rival barons. Every decision, or lack thereof, can impact the long-term stability of your fiefdom.[/p][p]The entire map of Greenwood plays into this vision. Villages will have unique resources, encouraging structured trade, while crafting systems will feature blacksmiths of varying rarities to produce diverse tools, weapons, and armor. Combined with royal demands and competition from simulated barons, players will face meaningful challenges in both economy and strategy.[/p][p]With this shift in focus, we’ve updated our Roadmap accordingly.
[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/3d15f6226e2e25a2f8afbc5d4ea3cffebeb1446a.jpg"][/img][b]Noble Legacy 2025 Roadmap[/b]
[/h3][p]We’re moving the [b]Wildlands Update[/b] forward to focus on core mechanics of the player’s caput. This update introduces [b]wildlife[/b]—including wolves, boars, deer, and various fish—as part of our new minigame system. Tools are also being overhauled with full inventory integration and hotbar assignment. Maintaining and producing tools will now play a larger role in the economy, offering higher-tier equipment that improves villagers’ stats and efficiency.[/p][p]Wildlands also refines [b]farming[/b] with the addition of [b]Animal Husbandry[/b] (pastures, the Shepherd role), and the much-anticipated [b]Hunting Lodge[/b] with the Hunter role. Building mechanics will receive an overhaul as well, featuring a [b]framing system[/b] where villagers can be assigned to construction through the new [b]Construction Workshop[/b].[/p][p]Finally, players will gain the ability to construct their own [b]Lord’s Manor[/b], serving as the Baron’s beacon in their fiefdom.[/p][p]Looking ahead, we’ve also moved the [b]Life & Death Update[/b] up to winter. This update will overhaul [b]combat mechanics[/b], while introducing the [b]Apothecary[/b] (Healer role), [b]Bath House[/b] to prevent illness, the [b]Lord’s Mount[/b], and more.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"][/img][/p][h3]
[b]You have asked for it. Multiplayer Coop. [/b][/h3][p]Due to the overwhelming feedback and requests, we have decided to align on multiplayer coop which is slated for the Life & Death Update. We will have more details to come regarding specifics on multiplayer coop, but we can confirm that production has officially begun work.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Localization: French & Russian
localisation en français / Новая локализация: русский[/b][/h3][p]Based on player demand and community demographics, we are introducing [b]localization for French and Russian[/b]. As development continues, new content and text will require ongoing updates, so we kindly ask for your patience as we expand and refine localization with each milestone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/91985e6e8e9cdb4df658fbea5eb7b4d4bcd276bd.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Incoming Patch for 9/5/2025[/b]
[/h3][p]We are prepped to release a patch tomorrow - included are the following list of notes and changes[/p][h3][b]
Gameplay & AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added new mines, several new lakes and ponds throughout the map.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs hosting conversations will no longer idle while waiting for partner[/p][/*][*][p]Navigation updates:[/p][list][*][p]Navigation improvements to reduce NPCs taking unnecessary detours[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted navigation within Mineshaft tunnels for better AI pathing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Resource and crafting fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed ability to swap between foundry and tavern recipes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with berries being placed into woodpiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed workers not mining Iron.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Crafting Jobs “Crafted Item” storage messaging.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Recruitment & events:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed out-of-sync recruitment pool timer.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Building & placement fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed collisions with windowed walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed window with shutter misalignment when upgrading T2 to T3.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed stone trim gaps when snapping to roof.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blocking volumes interfering with some NPC spawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted furniture and bookshelf collision boxes for easier decoration placement, including 3-shelf items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed decoration placement difficulty.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Art & visual fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed road weather masking so snow collects naturally and foot particles are smoother.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Art & Visual Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Optimized materials, lighting, and post-processing for performance and visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized draw distances for resources, buildings, and mineshafts.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized LOD distances for trees, shrubs, and other environmental assets.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized all build part icons and UI assets to reduce overhead memory usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized landscape and texture compression for better performance with minimal quality loss.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated T3 window walls to allow proper shutters placement.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Quality of Life[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added character name length limit in the character creation screen.[/p][/*][/list][p] And that's a wrap for this week! Thank you all again for your continued support, and we are excited to share further details as we get closer to releasing them! See you in Greenwood![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes 0.1.53999
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes 0.1.53999[/h2][p][/p][p]This update addresses multiple issues from our first week of early access launch. Thanks to your feedback and assistance through launch, we have prioritized many of our critical bug fixes that impact the core gameplay pillars. In addition, we have added new decorative and build pieces highly requested by the community. 

Many of your requests have been heard - and to clarify, we are currently in discussion with regards to coop multiplayer and with an optional camera transition into first person mode. None of this is confirmed, but we wanted to make clear that your voices are heard, and we will continue evaluating. Localization efforts are currently underway for Russian and French languages. 

As always, thank you for supporting Noble Legacy, thanks for your patience and optimism - and we look forward to the next update in which we will announce soon along with our regularly scheduled hotfixes/patches. See you in Greenwood!
[/p][h3]
Highlights
[/h3][list][*][p] Resolved the 0/1 Visitors Bug [/p][/*][*][p] Addressed Hunger Issues with Visitors Eating/Drinking in Tavern[/p][/*][*][p] Stone will now respawn, adjusted respawn on all resources[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Villager Homeless and Job Conflicts as a result of Upgrading Structures[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Settings Reset issues causing player FOV to set to 1[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Collection Radius resetting after a reload[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Roads disappearing after save and when a player initially equips the Destruction Hammer[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Villagers dropping sacks[/p][/*][*][p] Building QOL, Snapping and a few new build parts for T3 Castle Set[/p][/*][/list][h3]

Building & Construction

[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Gameplay & Systems
[/h3][list][*][p] Enabled regeneration of stones, trees, berries, mushrooms, etc.[/p][/*][*][p] Chickens now produce eggs again.[/p][/*][*][p] Added cooldown to scaling raid events.[/p][/*][*][p] Added milestone: “Recruit 3 villagers” in sandbox mode.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed reliability of recruits in tutorial[/p][/*][*][p] Market stalls now refresh properly on game start.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed tithe box intent.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed max visitors calculation.[/p][/*][*][p] Improved visitor logic to better accommodate villages established away from spawn
[/p][/*][/list][h3]

[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Art & Visuals
[/h3][list][*][p] Updated castle materials and adjusted stone castle set (icons, pivots, gaps).[/p][/*][*][p] Added new rugs and updated existing rug designs.[/p][/*][*][p] Updated brick, stone foundation, trim, and floor materials.[/p][/*][*][p] Added new food crafting icons (fish stew, mushroom stew).[/p][/*][*][p] Tuned base materials, lighting, LUTs, and color grading for better visuals.[/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted blocking volumes to prevent players leaving the map or building outside bounds.

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update & Community Spotlight!
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/33a1c1ac17733f111b44332cdbc04bc2491a5aa6.png"][/img]Weekly Development Update[/h3][p][/p][p]As we wrap up our first week into Early Access, i'd like to thank you all for your support and continued feedback on Noble Legacy. This week, I wanted to share some development updates and the future of Noble Legacy.   Right now our primary focus is knocking out our hi priority bugs and features. We've had an overwhelming amount of feedback and have exposed certain issues we plan to address and will continue to do so. With your help we've been able to identify some critical issues, and take on feedback and requests for the high level vision of the game, which we are moving to action now. So thank you very much for keeping us accountable and assisting us as we trek forward in development.   [/p][p][/p][p]We have a significant patch coming soon with many changes, fixes and updates that were previously withheld to preserve the stability of the launch build. We are now rolling those changes in as we speak and testing internally and with our community focus testers on Discord.   Here are some of the top priorities for us in addressing. [/p][list][*][p][b]0/1 Visitors Bug[/b] - before visitors can visit your village, you must have at least 3 villagers and we've identified an issue that previously circumvented our last fix, reducing these issues from happening but have addressed it for visitor reliability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hunger Issues[/b] - This is our top priority at the moment along with the villagers dropping sacks of items. We are addressing this for this weeks patch and will provide more details in the notes to come. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Cold Effects and Home Fueling[/b] - There are a few critical steps we are missing to communicate to the player how to properly fuel homes - which involves manually fueling along with villagers self fueling. We have some unfinished mechanics here that we will be addressing including manual build of a home fireplace and a more clear fueling flow. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Build Snapping[/b] - Duplicates and Quality of Life - The T3 Castle Set which was slated in the roadmap was pushed early for testing at launch so that players had a wider array of build parts to work with. We're making improvements to the build system here, aligning build parts properly and addressing support issues. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Players unable to create a new character/edit[/b] (no character creation screen) - We are presently overhauling the Main Menu, and its mechanics under the hood to be more reliable and to ensure character creation is executed on a new game. Reminder - once a character is created you can always edit via the edit character button in the menu and clothing changes in the wardrobe. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Homeless and Job Assignments[/b] - We've identified an issue when deleting build parts for building classification that displays improper slots and boots villagers off jobs, with the workaround of reassignments. We'll be addressing this issue as well. [/p][/*][*][p][b]General Bugs and Polish[/b] - based on reports as they come in we'll continue to address and many of the minor bugs are being corrected as we speak. [/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for your patience and support as we navigate through these issues to address. This has been a critical priority for us. We are also continuing on course in terms of progression and content. We have a lot more decorative and build parts to come along with some core mechanic changes and adjustments that will provide clear communication and proper research unlocks in respect to building tier categories. [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/c11560d6b843cbf84a5008ce4cf9cc1b8f433896.png"][/img]Community Spotlight[/h3][p][/p][p]Check out this Japanese inspired Tavern Build by Noble Legacy Community Member, Satsuki Shizuka! Available on the Steam Workshop!
[/p][previewyoutube="mWtxj2jts88;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6bfe8ea0afe400694fad7af4498d1e361bcb9aaf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/3f2c5bd53344cf5697740712001d2c5ad997da87.jpg"][/img][/p]

tags.bug: [b]0/1 Visitors Bug[/b] - before visitors can visit your village, you must have at least 3 villagers and we've identified an issue that previously circumvented our last fix, reducing these issues from happening but have addressed it for visitor reliability.

[b]Hunger Issues[/b] - This is our top priority at the moment along with the villagers dropping sacks of items. We are addressing this for this weeks patch and will provide more details in the notes to come.

[b]Cold Effects and Home Fueling[/b] - There are a few critical steps we are missing to communicate to the player how to properly fuel homes - which involves manually fueling along with villagers self fueling. We have some unfinished mechanics here that we will be addressing including manual build of a home fireplace and a more clear fueling flow.

notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/b0458a918c88a7fb87bd15954983129dc156e8fa.png"][/img][b]Lords, Ladies, and People of the Realm![/b][/h1][p](yes, even the serfs, beggers, and ne'er do wells)[/p][p]
We are pleased to announce that Noble Legacy has now launched into Early Access and is available on Steam to download and play![/p][h3]
[b][u]Noble Legacy early access launch features:[/u][/b][/h3][p][b]Campaign Tutorial[/b] - Want to learn the ropes? Embark on your first campaign journey in Greenwood along with your most beloved Uncle Edward. (Don’t let him bother you, too much).

[b]Kingdom Mode[/b] - Establish your own village in the open world of Greenwood. Build, Collect Villagers, and create your own Fiefdom in our first 4km open world map. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/c11560d6b843cbf84a5008ce4cf9cc1b8f433896.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Collect Skilled Craftsmen[/b][/p][p]Attract the most valuable villagers in the land and turn them into loyal followers in your kingdom. Ensure their homes are properly furnished, entertainment is plentiful and provide cutting-edge tools to sustain their loyalty and boost their productivity. How many of the land’s greatest talents will you inspire to serve your cause?
[/p][p][b]Third-Person Kingdom Builder[/b][/p][p]Experience a deep kingdom management simulator elevated through a dynamic third-person perspective. Effortlessly toggle between a strategic top-down view to oversee and govern your realm, and an immersive third-person view to explore your lands, connect with your people, and build your kingdom’s future.
[/p][p][b]Steam Workshop Prefabs[/b] – Share your prefab creations with other Lords on the Steam Workshop! Rapidly grow your kingdom with pre-crafted buildings or meticulously design every structure to build a realm unlike any other. Save your unique creations and share them with fellow rulers through the Steam Workshop!

notes.title: Noble Legacy - Community Update
notes.content:
[h1]Noble Legacy - Community Update
[/h1][p]An updated demo is now live! We've spent the week fixing bugs, adding new content, and improving core systems. Here's what’s new:
[/p][h2][b]Game/Demo Updates[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Female Characters added to Character Creation Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Demo now live with new content and improvements  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixes addressing bugs, polish, and overall stability  [/p][/*][*][p]Performance improvements across the board for smoother gameplay  [/p][/*][*][p]Sandbox Mode improvements for better creative freedom and control [/p][/*][*][p]Research Tree overhaul – redesigned for clarity and progression flow  [/p][/*][*][p]AI Villager improvements – smarter behaviors, better pathing, and job handling  [/p][/*][*][p]Building System improvements – cleaner placement, better snapping, and feedback  [/p][/*][*][p]New road placement controls – more precise and user-friendly  [/p][/*][*][p]Economy balancing – refined trade, income, and resource flow  [/p][/*][*][p]Save reliability improvements – we've made adjustments to improve stability; any reports or confirmations from the community are extremely helpful [/p][/*][/list][h2]Coming Soon[/h2][list][*][p]We are officially confirming German Localization (Wir bestätigen offiziell die deutsche Lokalisierung.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]EA Launch - [/b]EA Launch has originally been slated for late July but has been set a few weeks back to early August. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Community Updates[/b][/h2][h3]Introducing: [b]The Noble Council[/b][/h3][p]A new community testing group helping us find bugs, refine mechanics, and improve the overall experience. They have also been assisting our team in testing the reliability of Workshop integration as well as player to developer feedback and suggestions. If this is a program you'd be interested in participating please join our Discord Community at [url="https://discord.com/invite/jGA5PfqC8P"]https://discord.com/invite/jGA5PfqC8P[/url]

[b]Community Contributions![/b] 
We have some fantastic builds that we are excited to share created by the fine folks in The Noble Council. 

[b]The Laughing Gnoll - [/b]by Megan (Onyx)[/p][p]Cozy fire? Check. Questionable stew made from “local mushrooms”? Double check. Five rooms upstairs if you’ve had one too many meads, and stalls out back for your horse—or your mother-in-law.[/p][p]Whether you're here for the gossip, the ale, or just to escape the weather, The Laughing Gnoll has you covered. Just don’t ask why it’s laughing. Seriously. Don’t.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/46e8342601c50bddb0541dbcab0e2114295ea89b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6659ced1846198fbf07154b4817b92eaf246fe6f.jpg"][/img]

[b]The Kings Cross Inn[/b] by Kingsmen
A quaint 1 story flat Inn that sits at the crossroads, makes this a comfortable spot for any traveler looking to lay their head for the night!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/656833e5efb8c1cdfef1bbbce59c6536200d6640.png"][/img]
[b]Hybrid Tavern and Stables [/b]by Kate Kaplan[/p][p]
Crafted by the talented [b]Kate Kaplan[/b], this brilliantly chaotic prefab—formerly known as the modestly named [i]Tavern Stable Hybrid[/i]—has been lovingly transformed into what we now call [b]The Prancing Potato[/b].[/p][p]Equal parts [b]bar[/b], [b]inn[/b], and [b]stable[/b], it’s the kind of place where you can grab a drink, crash for the night, and park your horse—all without stepping outside. From fancy guest rooms for the coin-heavy traveler to budget bunks for the thrifty, there's something here for everyone.[/p][p]Food? Yes. Furniture? Tons. Charm? Unquestionable. Come for the ale, stay for the potatoes... they might even dance.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554882/6375fbbc787063fa59a0a78c857e8918fb2e3c9e.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Thanks for your continued support. If you are interested in Noble Legacy, we appreciate your support, follow the game and add to your wishlist!

[/i]

Stay tuned — more to come![/p][p][/p]
